errors.text_span: 横轴表示实体的类别...纵轴表示实体的数量
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the horizontal and vertical axes. The horizontal axis (横轴) represents the quantity (实体数量), and the vertical axis (纵轴) represents the categories (实体类别).
The list of categories is incomplete; it omits the category '手术治疗' (Surgical Treatment).
The description incorrectly states that '实体数目' is the label for the vertical axis. '实体数目' is the title of the entire chart, not an axis label.

errors.text_span: 每个柱状图使用不同的颜色标记
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the bars have different colors. The image shows all bars are the same color (blue).

errors.text_span: 其中“疾病”柱状图对应的值为3682，“症状”柱状图对应的值为2049，“检查”柱状图对应的值为1010，“药物治疗”柱状图对应的值为155
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps values to categories. The correct values are: '疾病' is 1399, '症状' is 3682, '检查' is 2049, and '药物治疗' is 1010.

errors.text_span: 最长的柱状图对应“疾病”类型
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the longest bar. The longest bar corresponds to '症状' (Symptom), not '疾病' (Disease).

errors.text_span: 最短的柱状图对应“药物治疗”类型
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the shortest bar. The shortest bar corresponds to '手术治疗' (Surgical Treatment), not '药物治疗' (Drug Treatment).
